controller.base: C33 fixed reference with alpha=1, r=.05, K=4/(1-2r), original body reference XY and lambda=.5
controller.force_law: F_new_xy = F_old_xy + mass*body_kd*beta*v_reference_xy; Fz and all moments unchanged
controller.new_parameter: beta in {0,.5,1}, constant per episode, change only idle before begin_episode
controller.qualification_note: The unchanged .015 m budget bounds reference acceleration only. Adding beta changes commanded wrench authority and may increase actual force/acceleration; no claim that total acceleration is capped by .015 m. Original force allocation, torque limits, native safety and effort gates remain active.
controller.reference_velocity: Same C33 saved reference_tick and curve derivative, world frame. Apply only when current phase remains the tick source phase in shift/recenter, failure is None and cancellation has not been requested. It is exactly zero for all other phases and t>=T.
unchanged: body reference acceleration and original .015 m commanded ZMP budget
all original native/source/physical/contact/margin/speed/pose/torque and task quality gates except explicit new target-distance identity
C31 fixed body XY action/lambda, all foot phases and fixed leg order
one original model/plant/controller instance, B22 checkpoint, control dt .01 and physics dt .002

distance.report: Use commanded target D/T and actual retained progress/T separately. Overshoot never increases commanded-distance speed. 30 mm evidence is an external quality/throughput anchor, not a same-task 40 mm control.
distance.start_boundary: C34 adapter asserts the inherited Hybrid call supplied distance_m=.03 and passes explicitly configured D to original Fast.start. No Fast guard edit: .01<=D<=.04 remains. Save incoming/requested/applied D separately.

future_RL_requirement: C34 is neither training nor proof of sufficient RL authority. Before any RL contract, freeze the best reasonable same-task fixed comparator under identical available beta/distance/phase permissions using development data, and reserve new conditions for evaluation. Do not train merely to rediscover a single best constant beta or compare to an intentionally weak fixed setting.

required_before_physics: Source GO binds controller/task/worker/host/readers/contract plus complete actual cold reader import closure before launch.

Root alone runs bounded meaningful pure checks: beta0 exact identity, XY-only delta/phase/cancel masking, D30 equivalence/D40 true target, deterministic stage selection and budget arithmetic, source/bootstrap environment checks. No additional fitted models.
Environment site-packages stays first as actual bootstrap requires; LD_PRELOAD and library identities unchanged, Python3.10 and thread limits retained.
Independent reader must reconstruct new beta wrench/torque contribution and actual D40 target; no monkeypatch that declares old 30 mm task or old wrench valid for different inputs.

Reuse all remaining original physical/native verification and exact source/native counters. Saved verification may parallelize per episode only if full gates/all rows/global ledger are preserved and explicitly reviewed; no sampling shortcuts.
implementation_review.source_files: Only new continuation34 files. Do not edit sealed C30/C31/C32/C33 sources or artifacts.

pairing.30mm: D30 pre-actuation entry plans retain the exact C33 alpha1 base; beta affects wrench only after that entry.
pairing.entry_exceptions: Only explicitly commanded D and independently derived delta/goal/swing-duration fields may differ for40 mm; every other source/reset/checkpoint/profile/entry control field stays equal. Independently verify each actual planner/reference formula; no blanket exemption for teacher geometry or planned time.
pairing.prefix: Exact same seven initial arrays, first201 state arrays and first200 B22 control records as accepted nominal baseline; no tolerance relaxation.

purpose: Test whether bounded reference-velocity tracking recovers C33 settling losses, then quantify 40 mm target throughput within the original Fast.start distance range. This is fixed-control engineering; no RL benefit or fluent A/D completion is claimed.

quality.40mm_throughput_milestone: Both directions .04/T >=1.25*(.03/9.37), with all quality gates. Also separately report whether nonzero beta is >=5% shorter than the new D40 beta0 same-task control.
quality.all_cases: All C33/C31/C30 mandatory per-native safety and task/entry/cancel gates retained. 30 mm score exactly unchanged. 40 mm only goal D and stricter .035 lower progress gate change; .05 upper and .012 absolute position error retained.
quality.experience_limit: Even +25% throughput is only about .004 m/s. The unchanged ~4.24 s serial foot-phase cost prevents this task from proving fluent A/D; later work must provide effective foot timing/continuous scheduling authority and genuine state-dependent RL decisions.
quality.external_quality_anchors: For every successful development: final error <= corresponding C30 zero error+2 mm; retention>=max(.90,C30 zero retention-.02); full-scene torque-square mean <=1.10 C30 fixed and <=1.20 C30 zero. These are quality bounds, not claims of same-task comparison at D=.04.
quality.same_task_30mm_speed_milestone: Both directions T<=.95*C33 alpha1 D30 cycle (9.37 s). Report all attempts even if none meets it.
quality.same_task_40mm: Any nonzero beta40 additionally requires final error<=new beta0 D40 error+2 mm, retention>=max(.90,beta0 D40 retention-.02), full torque-square mean<=1.10 new beta0 D40 mean.

sequence.cancellation: If physical development closes without hard failure, select best complete eligible pair at largest attempted target distance. For a new selected setting, run cancel_d<030or040>_beta<tag>_left/right, at first real lift/horizontal overlap next control as C33. If selected setting is archived D=.03,beta0, reuse its existing C33 cancellation evidence and run no duplicate. At most two new cancellations.
sequence.case_order: Each complete setting is left before right, beta .5 before1 in stage A; beta0 before selected_A in stage B. Cycle indices are contiguous 0..attempted-1. No discretionary extra point.
sequence.controlled_quality_failure: After a safely closed controlled task/quality failure, stop remaining development points immediately; no higher beta or larger D. Only cancellation of an already eligible selected new setting may follow.
sequence.hard_failure: Any native/source/mandatory physical/entry/archive failure ends all further cases; close safely within reserved budget, no retry.
sequence.selection_A: Among eligible complete left/right pairs, include archived beta0; minimize max cycle time, then mean full-scene normalized torque-square mean, then smaller beta. No speed threshold needed for eligibility.
sequence.selection_B: Among eligible complete 40 mm pairs actually attempted, same worst-cycle/cost/smaller-beta ranking. The tested fixed set is disclosed; it is not claimed globally optimal.
sequence.stage_A_archived_control: C33 alpha_100_left/right at D=.03,beta=0; reuse exact independently accepted saved evidence, no rerun.
sequence.stage_B_40mm: If all four Stage A cases completed eligible, run d040_beta000_left/right, then d040_beta<selected_A>_left/right if selected_A is nonzero. If selected_A=0, do not duplicate beta0.
